description: This source file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC convention class 'GroupByApiRootConvention' that implements 'IControllerModelConvention'. The class modifies controller metadata based on route attributes to assign group names for API versioning.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: A class implementing IControllerModelConvention to set API group names based on route attributes.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Adjusts the controller's API explorer grouping based on the route attribute's template, assigning the first segment as the API version group.
